title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Step Functions with Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Translate and Amazon Polly
description: Start an AWS Step Functions workflow from Amazon API Gateway that transcribes speech, translates it and turns the result back into speech.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This patterns explains how to integrate API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, Transcribe, Translate, Polly and S3 to develop an audio language converter.
The API gateway exposes a websocket to keep the channel open for the process to complete and send response back.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
